wikitext:
== Update June 10, 2026 ==

=== Account Linking for Mobile ===

We've turned on "Account Linking" for participants in the mobile soft launch territories (Australia, New Zealand, The Philippines, Canada and Korea).

* To access account linking, login on your mobile device with your Apple or Google account.
* Select "Edit Account" from the character select screen.
* Select "Manage Account" on the next screen.
** This will take you to a web page where you can link your account.
** You can only link to an ArenaNet account that does not already have Guild Wars Reforged on it - this is to prevent you from accidentally losing access to your existing content.
** Once you have linked your account, you can log in to your mobile account on a PC by using the email and password of the linked account.

=== Target Date for Global Mobile Launch ===
We are targeting the morning of June 24th, 2026 (Pacific Time) to enable global access to the mobile clients.
* If you have an existing ArenaNet account you will be able to login to your mobile device for free with access to your existing content.
** Add your name to the appropriate app store wish list to be notified as soon as the game is available!
* You will be able to create new accounts by pressing the "Login with Google" or "Login with Apple" buttons as appropriate.
* We continue to work on getting "Login with Steam" to work so Steam players will be able to play on mobile devices for free but that is not guaranteed for June 24th.
